rawFindings.title: Incorrect URL path construction in PostAsset.path virtual
rawFindings.explanation: The change replaced url.resolve(post.path, this.slug) with path.join(post.path, this.slug). The post.path is typically a URL path (e.g., '/foo/'), not a filesystem path. Using path.join will treat the inputs as filesystem paths and use platform-specific separators (e.g., backslash on Windows), which is incorrect for URL paths. This can lead to incorrect URL construction, especially on Windows platforms where backslashes are used. url.resolve correctly resolves URLs, handling '/' separators and r
rawFindings.suggestion: Revert to using url.resolve(post.path, this.slug) for proper URL path construction or explicitly handle URL joining with a utility that respects URL semantics.
rawFindings.failureAfterChange: For a post.path of '/foo/' and slug 'bar', the returned path will be '/foo/bar' on POSIX but '\foo\bar' on Windows, which is invalid as a URL path. This leads to wrong asset URLs and broken links on Windows hosts.
